items.description: Product Hunt is a service that helps a user discover new apps, tech creations, hardware, and even job listings. Their website allows a user to login to add products and use an upvote system to rank products and showcase new trends. Their API, currently in sign-up phase, will allow developers to access their data on file to create 3rd party applications and web services. As release is TBA, this profile is pending further updates.
